reviews.author: Lynne R.
reviews.quote: I could hear people talking to me without a lot of background noise
reviews.text: I finally got the settings correct so I wore one to church today. I only wore one because I am putting some drops in my other ear (doctor prescribed, only temporary) and didn't want to get the drops in the hearing aid. I could hear people talking to me without a lot of background noise and without nodding & smiling, pretending to hear them. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Bobby S.
reviews.quote: I can hear sounds I have never heard before
reviews.text: I finally got mine and the information on how to use was wonderful and I've been using them all day today and I can hear sounds I have never heard before and I love it! thank you so much Nebroo!!!

reviews.author: Dan L.
reviews.quote: Thank you for this affordable and nice working hearing aids.
reviews.text: Got my Nebroo today. Invited my girlfriend over to help coach me and we did it and they've been in all day. Comfortable and very good. I don't have a serious hearing issue so these are perfect. Thank you for this affordable and nice working hearing aids.
